title: Metal Fabrication Machinery Supplier in Canada | NovoTech
meta_description: NovoTech Machine Tools sells, installs and supports metal fabrication machinery across Canada from Mississauga, ON: press brakes, lasers, band saws, rebar.
intro: Press brakes, fiber lasers, band saws, rebar benders, plate rollers, ironworkers, deburring machines and press brake tooling from manufacturers in Turkey, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, Taiwan and China. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, and NovoTech installs it, trains your operators and keeps the parts in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.
hero_points: Showroom and parts warehouse in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada
CSA-approved electrical panel and a 1-year warranty on every machine
Installation, operator training and technical support anywhere in Canada

intro_video.title: NovoTech Machine Tools — who we are and what we sell

quote.intro: Tell us what you need to cut, bend, roll or finish — material, thickness, length and how many parts — and we will recommend the machine and come back with pricing, delivery and the right voltage for your shop.

work_slides.title: Rebar benders and cutters
work_slides.line: Stationary and portable rebar benders, hydraulic cutters, stirrup and spiral benders and automatic lines, #3 to #18.

work_slides.title: Band saws
work_slides.line: Manual, semi-automatic, automatic and double-column band saws from Ø9″ to 87″ — whole bundles in one cut.

work_slides.title: Aluminum and PVC saws
work_slides.line: Upcut, double-head, glazing bead and miter saws for aluminum extrusions and vinyl window profiles, with Ø17-11/16″ to Ø25-9/16″ blades.

work_slides.title: Band saw blades
work_slides.line: WIKUS MARATHON M42 bimetal and FUTURA carbide-tipped blades, welded to length in Canada, 1/2″ to 3-1/8″ wide in every tooth pitch.

work_slides.title: Angle rolls and section benders
work_slides.line: From a 2 HP ring roller to HEB 600 beam benders — rings, arcs and spirals in pipe, tube, angle and flat bar.

work_slides.kicker: Roll plate into cylinders and cones
work_slides.title: Plate rollers
work_slides.line: Hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rolls to 20 ft and 3-3/8″ plate, NC and CNC, plus motorized rolls from 3.4 ft.

work_slides.title: Press brakes
work_slides.line: CNC hydraulic, hybrid and servo-electric press brakes from 22 to 1,323 US tons and 4 to 20 ft.

work_slides.title: Sheet metal brakes and folders
work_slides.line: Hand, box and pan, magnetic and roofing brakes up to hydraulic, electric and CNC folding machines — up to 20 ft.

work_slides.title: Horizontal press brakes
work_slides.line: NC hydraulic horizontal presses from 11 to 165 US tons that bend, punch, shear and straighten flat bar, pipe, bar and busbar.

work_slides.title: CNC panel benders
work_slides.line: Automatic panel benders from 47 to 165″ bend width — push-down and suction-cup machines for boxes, doors and cabinet panels.

work_slides.title: CNC V-grooving machines
work_slides.line: Horizontal machines with 10.5 to 20 ft tables for sheet to 5/32″, and vertical machines to 13 ft for plate to 1/4″ — for sharp, zero-radius bends.

work_slides.title: Press brake tooling
work_slides.line: EUROSTAMP punches, dies, holders and adapters made in Italy, for Amada-Promecam, Trumpf, Wila, Bystronic, LVD and American-style press brakes.

work_slides.title: Fiber laser cutting machines
work_slides.line: Sheet and plate fiber lasers from 4 × 4 ft to 10 × 164 ft and 1.5 to 80 kW, with shuttle tables, loaders and sorting.

work_slides.title: Tube laser cutting machines
work_slides.line: Round, square and rectangular tube, angle, channel and beam from Ø0.3″ to 25.2″ in 20 to 40 ft bars — with automatic loaders, zero-tail chucks and bevel heads.

work_slides.kicker: Weld and clad with a laser
work_slides.title: Laser welding machines
work_slides.line: Handheld and portable laser welders from 0.8 to 3 kW, robotic laser welding cells to 20 kW, cobot MIG welders and laser cladding.

work_slides.title: Ironworkers
work_slides.line: Hydraulic ironworkers from 44 to 276 US tons: punch plate, shear flat bar and angle, notch — single- and double-piston.

work_slides.title: Shears
work_slides.line: Hydraulic guillotine and swing beam shears, CNC and NC, and mechanical shears — from 16 ga sheet to 1-9/16″ plate, 4 to 20 ft long.

work_slides.title: Corner notchers
work_slides.line: Hydraulic corner notchers that cut a 90° or 30° – 140° corner out of sheet to 1/4″ in one stroke.

work_slides.title: Plate bevelers
work_slides.line: Self-feeding cold bevelers for V, X, K and Y weld preps in plate and pipe from 1/8″ to 4-3/4″ thick — shearing and milling heads.

work_slides.title: Pipe and tube benders
work_slides.line: CNC, NC, all-electric and hydraulic mandrel and rotary-draw benders, from Ø15/32″ tube to Ø8-5/8″ pipe.

work_slides.title: Tube and pipe notchers
work_slides.line: Belt-sander notchers for tube from 11/16″ to 3-1/2″ OD at any angle to 50°, with ten drums included.

work_slides.title: CNC wire bending machines
work_slides.line: 3D CNC wire benders fed straight from the coil, Ø5/32″ to Ø9/16″ — baskets, racks, frames, hooks and exhaust hangers.

work_slides.title: Tube end forming machines
work_slides.line: Expand, reduce, bead, flare and groove tube ends — from Ø3-1/2″ expander-reducers to CNC machines for Ø23.6″ tube.

work_slides.title: Circle cutters and flanging machines
work_slides.line: Circle shears for discs and rings to Ø78.7″ in 3/16″ plate, and cutting and flanging machines for dished tank heads to Ø15 ft.

work_slides.title: Bead rollers
work_slides.line: Hydraulic and motorized bead rollers for sheet to 8 ga, with beading, swaging and flanging roll sets.

work_slides.title: Hydraulic presses
work_slides.line: Shop presses from 10 US tons, H-frame and four-column production presses, C-frame presses and straightening presses — to 661 US tons, larger to order.

work_slides.title: Deburring and finishing machines
work_slides.line: Dry and wet machines that deburr, round the edges and finish laser-, plasma- and punch-cut parts, 5-7/8″ to 53-1/8″ wide.

work_slides.title: Pipe sanding and polishing machines
work_slides.line: Tube sanders and pipe polishers for straight and bent tube — automatic feed, orbital, centreless and large-pipe sanders.

work_slides.title: Corner grinders
work_slides.line: Hand-fed, automatic and PLC corner grinders that grind the welds on boxes, cabinets, doors and tube frames flush or to a radius.

work_slides.kicker: Turn, tilt and hold the work
work_slides.title: Welding automation
work_slides.line: Welding positioners from 22 to 44,092 lb, turning rolls to 220,462 lb, column and boom manipulators and welding tables.

work_slides.title: Corner welding machines
work_slides.line: 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-axis TIG and plasma corner welders for bent boxes in steel, stainless and aluminum, with laser seam reading.

work_slides.title: Drill presses
work_slides.line: Gear-head drill presses for 1 – 2″ holes in steel with power feed and tapping, plus inverter, belt-drive and column drills.

work_slides.title: Milling machines
work_slides.line: Turret mills with a horizontal spindle, universal and ISO50 mills, drill-mills, keyseaters and a cylinder head resurfacer.

work_slides.title: CNC lathes
work_slides.line: Slant-bed CNC lathes with Fanuc control, 12-station servo turret, 6″ to 12″ chucks, Ø27.6″ swing and C-axis live tooling.

work_slides.title: CNC machining centres
work_slides.line: Vertical machining centres with BBT40 spindles, 10,000 rpm and 24 tools, and double-column machines with BBT50 and X travel to 161.4″.

work_slides.title: Surface grinders
work_slides.line: The TGH-B 450 NC surface grinder: 17.7 × 35.4″ table, Ø13.8″ wheel and NC down feed in 0.00004″ steps.

work_slides.title: Aluminum and PVC window machinery
work_slides.line: Welders, corner cleaners, CNC machining centres, copy routers, end mills, corner crimpers and complete lines for vinyl and aluminum windows and doors.

work_slides.title: Woodworking machinery
work_slides.line: Jointers, thickness planers, jointer-planers, 10″ table saws, band saws, slot boring machines, a lathe and a dust collector.
